create_sample_from_dataframe: create a Sample from a pandas DataFrame using Sample.from_frame with id and weight columns
convert_sample_to_sample_frame: convert a Sample to a SampleFrame using to_sample_frame to extract covariate data
convert_sample_to_balance_frame: convert a Sample with a target to a BalanceFrame using to_balance_frame
deepcopy_sample: create an independent deep copy of a Sample using the __deepcopy__ method
set_sample_target: set a target Sample on a Sample using set_target to enable BalanceFrame behavior
